hostname.description: Server hostname for DID doc and proxy refs

service-id.description: Service ID in the DID document

keepalive-ms.description: How often to probe each registered subscriber for liveness (detects dead half-open WSS connections)

keepalive-timeout-ms.description: How long a keepalive probe may take before the subscriber is evicted (eviction triggers the client to reconnect)

additional-hosts.description: Comma-separated extra hostnames accepted on control endpoints. "*" allows all.

allowed-dids.description: Comma-separated DIDs allowed to register. Empty = allow all.

plc-directory-url.description: PLC directory used to resolve did:plc subscriber signing keys for service-auth verification

tls-cert-file.description: PEM certificate to serve TLS with; requires tls-key-file

tls-key-file.description: PEM private key to serve TLS with; requires tls-cert-file

port-file.description: File the bound TCP port is written to once listening (used with port 0)
